market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are a solid mid-table Premier League side with low historical relegation risk; pre-season bookmaker odds for similar clubs typically imply a 8–12% chance, well below the 34.5% priced here. While any team can struggle, the current market price overstates the tail risk significantly, making 'No' a value play.
evidence_points: Pre‑season betting markets for comparable clubs have implied relegation probabilities around 8–12% in recent years.
West Ham have consistently stayed up since 2012–13, with squad investment and league position typically outside the bottom six.
The 2025–26 season field includes newly promoted sides that bear the bulk of relegation risk, further reducing the likelihood for an established club like West Ham.
